defunct: Nothing outside this repo says this series runs. No scraper has ever produced it: it was hand-added as a venue hub in data/venues.json (commit 9e5d48e, 2026-06-15) and never corroborated. blackmambasalsa.com is a hard 404 and facebook.com/blackmambasalsa's last event was Apr 2021. Our record claimed 2nd Sunday monthly; a third-party listing claims 3rd Saturday with Rumba Y Timbal, so even the schedule was unverified. CAUTION: 'DJ Black Mamba' appears in other events' lineups (e.g. Querencia's 5-Year Anniversary) — that is the DJ, not this social, and is NOT evidence the series is back. Do not re-add as a venue hub without a live organizer page listing actual dates.
